progressionAssessment.rationale: All covered offerings and earlier formal prerequisites checked. PPD is in year one; BENGATE102 precedes advanced economics and legal foundation precedes legal dependents.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Law, Society & Justice Actual legal foundations, institutions, justice and public/private law supply legal context for economic regulation, without teaching fiscal legislation.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Entrepreneurship & Business Foundations Actual firm organisation, stakeholders, business decisions and value creation provide business context for economic effects on firms; no tax-planning sequence.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Taxation, redistribution and economic choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Economics Actual micro/macro models, incentives, strategic interaction and market/aggregate analysis provide substantive foundations for fiscal-policy questions.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Taxation, redistribution and economic choices”.

basisLabels: Empirical economic analysis and research
courseTraceability.rationale: Research Methods & Statistics Actual measurement, survey/experimental design, sampling, inference and introductory regression supply empirical tools; not a fiscal-methods specialisation.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Empirical economic analysis and research”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Public International Law Actual international legal sources, responsibility and institutions provide a bounded legal framework; no tax treaties or international tax doctrine are inferred.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Comparative Constitutional Law Actual constitutional/public institutions and administrative principles support government/regulation inquiry; not Dutch fiscal procedure.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Theory of International Relations International-relations theories, institutions and country-position research provide specific context for cross-border political/economic decisions, not international tax law.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices”.

basisLabels: Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Human Rights: Law & Philosophy Actual rights, dignity, equality and legal/philosophical argument add normative criteria for fairness questions; no specialised taxpayer-rights doctrine.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices”.

basisLabels: Taxation, redistribution and economic choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Behavioral Economics Description-only: actual psychological deviations, biases, framing and experiments extend economic decision analysis; tax-compliance experiments are not promised.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Taxation, redistribution and economic choices”.

basisLabels: Taxation, redistribution and economic choices
courseTraceability.rationale: International Macroeconomics Actual macroeconomic models, growth, expectations, fiscal/monetary policy and open economies provide substantive fiscal-policy/economic-effects analysis.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Taxation, redistribution and economic choices”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Accounting & Corporate Finance Actual financial statements, management accounting, budgets, costs and discounted investment appraisal supply accounting/firm substance. Tilburg also teaches business administration and management accounting.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Foundations of European Union Law Actual EU institutions, competences, free movement and enforcement supply EU legal foundations, not state-aid/direct-tax analysis as a specialised fiscal sequence.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Taxation, redistribution and economic choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Microeconomics & Behavior Actual labour/capital markets, market power, externalities and government intervention give economic tools for analysing fiscal incidence/incentives. Detailed tax-law applications are not asserted as taught.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Taxation, redistribution and economic choices”.

basisLabels: Taxation, redistribution and economic choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Public Economics Actual public goods, efficiency/equity, expenditure, health/welfare/social insurance, taxation and redistribution directly sustain public-finance inquiry. This goes beyond generic economic coherence, but does not reproduce Dutch tax-base/rate doctrine.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Taxation, redistribution and economic choices”.

basisLabels: Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Public Policy Analysis Description-only: policy-making phases, alternative conceptualisations and policy memos through a sugar case support policy analysis; the case is not automatically a taught tax experiment.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Principles of Private Law Actual property/tort/contract doctrine and comparative IRAC/case research, including France/Germany/England/China/US, provide substantive private-law context for business decisions. No fiscal statute or Dutch tax computation is inferred.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices
courseTraceability.rationale: European Union Politics Actual European decision rules, actors and policy-document inquiry supply political/institutional context for cross-border fiscal-policy questions.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: International Business & Governance Actual international business strategy, institutional governance and ethics support analysis of multinational business decisions; not international tax structures/treaty planning.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Empirical economic analysis and research
courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Data Science Actual data cleaning, transformation, visualisation and exploratory questions supply concrete empirical workflow; a tax dataset or project is not guaranteed.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Empirical economic analysis and research”.

basisLabels: Empirical economic analysis and research
courseTraceability.rationale: Econometrics Description-only: OLS/GLS/instrumental variables, inference, Monte Carlo work and an empirical paper sustain economic causal/predictive inquiry. No fiscal dissertation equivalence.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Empirical economic analysis and research”.

basisLabels: Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation
courseTraceability.rationale: Money, Banking & Finance Actual asset valuation, risk, banking regulation and financial instruments supply finance and investment context; not complete advanced corporate finance or tax accounting.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Business finance, accounting and the public and private legal institutions of taxation”.

basisLabels: Empirical economic analysis and research
courseTraceability.rationale: Qualitative Research Methodology Actual qualitative design, interviews, coding/reflexivity and a team inquiry supply qualitative empirical methods; no fiscal interview project is guaranteed.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Empirical economic analysis and research”.

basisLabels: Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices
courseTraceability.rationale: Ethics Actual consequentialist/Kantian/virtue/feminist theories and close argumentative reading supply substantive ethical judgement for fairness questions without being a specialised fiscal-ethics course.. It implements the explicit academic basis “Fairness, public policy and the ethics of fiscal choices”.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Accounting and finance address business decisions, but the available courses do not build a second programme in the taxation of profits or multinational firms. Redistribution, ethics, government and empirical policy analysis already organise the closest programme.

comparator.note: Genuine choice among exchange/study abroad, a 24-ECTS internship plus a 6-ECTS elective, or Economics and Management minors.
Compulsory bachelor thesis; students start in semester 1 or semester 2, for a total of 6 ECTS.

notes.text: Tilburg teaches income, profit, corporate and value-added taxation and formal tax procedure. UCR studies how fiscal policy affects decisions and welfare.

audience.programmeDescription: Students combine economics, business and law to examine taxation of income, wealth, profits and consumption. They develop economic and financial analysis alongside tax law, ethics and thesis research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR combination studies how taxes and public spending affect households and firms. Tilburg develops that economic inquiry alongside specialist courses in income tax, corporate tax, VAT and tax procedure.

curriculum.routeLabel: 2026 entrants; Dutch-language bachelor; no separate track selected
curriculum.limitation: The 180-EC pathway includes 30 EC of genuine choice space and one required 6-EC thesis, which may start in either semester. GROW carries 0 EC. Tax assistance is an optional elective within the choice space.

componentNotes.y3-choice-space: 30 EC through exchange, a 24-EC internship plus a 6-EC elective, or Economics and Management minors. No particular elective is assumed.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: One compulsory 6-EC thesis; the two possible starting semesters do not create two theses.
